metadata.title: Cloud Platform-as-a-Service Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securely consuming provider-managed application platforms where the operating system and runtime are not directly controlled by the consumer.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud platform services including managed runtimes, function platforms, application services, and provider-managed execution environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trust assumptions and shared responsibility boundaries for Platform-as-a-Service environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: PaaS trust assumptions depend on underlying hosting model and provider operational controls.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: PaaS security relies on trusted cloud management and automation control planes.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Platform-as-a-Service Core defines the baseline trust properties for consuming provider-managed application platforms. This pattern explicitly models the shift in responsibility away from the operating system and runtime toward identity, configuration, data access, and provider-managed security controls.

components.title: PaaS Runtime Trust Boundary
components.description: Trust boundary between consumer workloads and provider-managed runtimes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of exposed PaaS application services or platform endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation controls enforced by the provider-managed runtime environment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Separation of user functionality from provider-managed execution layers.
Security design principles applied to shared runtime platforms.

components.title: PaaS Configuration Responsibility
components.description: Governance of configuration settings that remain under consumer control in PaaS environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Defense evasion through disabling or weakening PaaS security configuration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit definition and governance of consumer-owned PaaS configuration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline configuration for consumer-controlled PaaS settings.
Configuration settings established and maintained for PaaS components.

components.title: PaaS Service Identity Control
components.description: Governance of identities and permissions used by PaaS services and applications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid service identities or service principals in PaaS environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Least-privilege lifecycle management of PaaS service identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege for PaaS service identities.
Protection of service identity credentials and tokens.
Enforcement of approved authorizations for PaaS services.
